learning_outcomes.text: Develop proposals, in the form of projects, appropriated to a development issue which falls under the identification and / or the design of a technical device, economic, socio-cultural.
Identify and define questions and problematics: Draw specifications.
Identify and define questions and problematics: Analyze a context.
Identify and define questions and problematics: Analyze a problematic.
Identify and define questions and problematics: To introduce the concept of systemic.
Identify and define questions and problematics: Find out the levers and constraints of a project.
Identify and define questions and problematics: Understand the life stages of a group.
Establish innovative proposals: Discovering and implementing technologies that foster innovation and creativity.
Establish innovative proposals: Discovering suitable and sustainable technologies.
Establish innovative proposals: Introduce the principles of sustainable development and its application in engineering projects.
Establish innovative proposals: Preparing for the mission on the field.
Establish innovative proposals: Soaking the iterative process.
Assess the feasibility and impact of proposals drawn: Understanding the technological balance as coming in support of human evolution.
Assess the feasibility and impact of proposals drawn: Identify suitable tools to measure the impact of a project.
Assess the feasibility and impact of proposals drawn: To contribute to the visibility of IngénieuxSud projects.
Develop and adopt a reflexive attitude on questions and development issues and find appropriate solutions: Carrying a critical look at their own skills, knowledge and his own limits.

Develop and adopt a reflexive attitude on questions and development issues and find appropriate solutions: Defining the various project issues (cultural, social, economic, technical) through a systems approach.
Develop and adopt a reflexive attitude on questions and development issues and find appropriate solutions: Continuously analyze the evolution of his thinking throughout the project.
Team work, collaborate effectively with national and international partners: Identify the contribution and complementary interests of the partners in the project issue.
Team work, collaborate effectively with national and international partners: Plan your teamwork: building a timetable, an apprenticeship program, ...
Team work, collaborate effectively with national and international partners: Self-evaluate its individual involvement in the group and the cooperation within the project and its group.

Communicate effectively orally and in writing with a wide spectrum of national and international audience (scientific experts, peers, teachers, trainers,...): Use appropriate means to dialogue with different audiences and partners.

Communicate effectively orally and in writing with a wide spectrum of national and international audience (scientific experts, peers, teachers, trainers,...): Provide feedback and suggest future prospects.

Communicate effectively orally and in writing with a wide spectrum of national and international audience (scientific experts, peers, teachers, trainers,...): Write an intercultural Portfolio, consistent, well structured, scientifically rigorous and critical thinking.

Communicate effectively orally and in writing with a wide spectrum of national and international audience (scientific experts, peers, teachers, trainers,...): Adapt your communication according to his interlocutors (peers, colleagues, teachers, trainers, scientists,...).

syllabus_topics: Science and technology for sustainable development
Interculturalism: exchange of points of view, regard, fresh perspective on the same scientific problem
The development of the project as part of a development cooperation program
The application of a systemic approach in a scientific project
The development of a concrete project: the definition of the problem specifications to the practical application
Factors that influence the project (social, country, population, external constraints, planning,...)
Teamwork and communication (with Southern partners, with people in the group, with technical and development experts, the local population and authorities,')
teaching_methods: Hybrid formation (online and face to face)
Coaching by scientific and academic bodies, field professionals (North and South)

assessment_methods.method: Portfolio (continuous assessment) group with individual parts
Oral group presentations in front of an interdisciplinary panel
Oral defense of the project before moving and implementing the technical solution in the concerned Southern country

bibliography: M. Ashby, (2016), « Materials and sustainable development », Elsevier Science and technology, UK.
Revue Spore : Le magazine du développement agricole et rural des pays ACP - http://spore.cta.int
